arguments.command:
cd /workspace && for a in "" "big"; do echo "=== $a"; python3 - << EOF
import time, resource, subprocess, sys
t0=time.time()
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'],stdin=open('/workspace/tmp/stress$a.json','rb'),capture_output=True,timeout=300)
dt=time.time()-t0
open('/workspace/tmp/out$a.json','wb').write(r.stdout)
print('%.2fs'%dt, 'outMB %.1f'%(len(r.stdout)/1e6), 'rc',r.returncode, r.stderr[:300])
print('maxrss %.0f MiB'%(resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss/1024))
EOF
done
